verdict.rationale: The IAM docs say teams can authenticate through Claude for Teams or Enterprise, the Claude Console, or a cloud provider. Enterprise adds SSO/SAML, domain capture, role-based permissions, a compliance API and managed policy settings for Claude Code. Missing for 10: details on which cloud platforms are supported and how cloud-provider authentication is configured, specifics of the SSO/SAML setup flow, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
